cuisine_chef.name: La cuisine du chef · Chef’s Kitchen
cuisine_chef.alt: The kitchen team prepares a tasting supper, passing dishes from the cooking range to the serving pass. bowl of mashed potatoes with resting potato ricer; adult organizer with a long checklist and pencil near his mouth; small savory tart covered with mustard and a simple cow face; adult grandmother tending a rectangular barbecue grill; eggs, flour sack and butter grouped on a gray slate board; adult cook with one long dark vanilla pod; small oven with visible roast and a clear hourglass timer beside it; shy mouse lifting a silver cloche from an elegant small plate; red salsa in a white bowl beside two maracas; blue-aproned fisherwoman and a pot of orange fish stew with visible fish pieces; proud chef in a white toque presenting a composed tasting plate. Ground-floor demonstration kitchen reached directly through the restaurant service entrance.

degustation.name: Le passe des saveurs · Tasting Pass
degustation.alt: The kitchen team tastes a soup and dessert before service and adjusts their flavors. recipe book with food diagrams and round reset-arrow control; adult taster puckering at dark chocolate with a coffee cup beside him; copper vegetable-soup pot with looping steam; adult female cook savoring a wooden spoonful; flat-cap deli worker with a strawberry tart and raised waving hand; white-toque cook stirring a saucepan; seated adult taster eating purple fruit puree

preparation.name: Le plan de préparation · Preparation Bench
preparation.alt: The team prepares a grilled-fish plate with fries, beans and mint sauce. older aunt in a straw hat tending a terracotta mint plant; adult cook chopping cucumber at a board beside prepared bowls; paper-boat serving tray of golden French fries; adult server pouring sauce onto a cooked fish from a sauceboat; two pieces of bread with dark grill stripes cooling on a rack; sunglasses cat beside a golden whisk and mixing bowl; shaggy cow with two horns leaning through a window and eating a green bean above a colander

service.name: L’accueil et le service · Welcome and Service
service.alt: The team welcomes adult diners at reception, checks an order and bill, and prepares food service. adult waitress writes an order on a notepad at the left reception desk. long bill curling from a small adding machine on the left desk. a silver buffet trolley with covered dishes and plates. large architectural dollhouse model of a restaurant with dining tables and an awning on the right reception counter. an adult male waiter holding a tray close to his chest. tired adult hiker resting in a chair with backpack at his feet on the right

cave.name: La cave et le conditionnement · Cellar and Bottling
cave.alt: An adult cellar team prepares sealed bottles and checks the corking tools below the restaurant. small calm calf resting on straw inside a recessed left stone alcove. large empty green bottle beside an upright boot at left. a large red foil capsule being fitted over a closed bottle neck. clear glass of water resting on a right ledge. sealed wine bottles in an open wooden crate at right. an adult cellar worker inspecting a cork stopper in his hand. single large oak barrel on a low right cradle. large corkscrew on the right foreground workbench

terroir.name: Le terroir et les arômes · Origins and Aromas
terroir.alt: Adult staff explain vineyard origins and food aromas at a daylight cellar workshop, with no drinking. potted grape vine with purple bunches on the far left. official-looking wine-origin certificate with a simple vineyard map and wax seal at left. a blank brass interpretation plaque on a small wooden stand. cheese and bread samples prepared for a food tasting. detailed terrain model of vineyard rows on a right table. one sealed bottle with a vineyard-origin tag on a right plinth. adult food lover smelling a covered dish he has just opened on the right. sealed cider bottle beside two apples on the right foreground
